g.text: AIR-GAPPED 7-TOOL MCP PIPELINE • GITHUB COMMIT GROUNDING • LANGFUSE OBSERVABILITY • ZERO-ORPHAN CLAIMS
Pure serverless JS PDF proxy extractor.
Base64 inline stream direct to Gemini Vision.
Decodes scanned images, bad fonts, photos.
Direct byte operator parser for corrupt headers.
Never let a stochastic model calculate candidate fit.
Tavily Search (8 SERPs) → Jina Deep Reader
Full Markdown extraction, strip ads, scripts, navbars
All researched company claims are rendered
in interactive cards for user vetting.
ZERO unvetted facts enter LLM context.
When JD requires a skill with ZERO evidence:
ALWAYS: "While I lack direct production in [X],
my deep background in [Y] gives me..."
Every single resume assertion MUST be followed
Without randomized jitter, recovered APIs get
instantly knocked offline by sync retries.
Deterministic regex scan strips seniority inflation.
If verb not in original resume, downgrades instantly.
Every sentence in UI renders with evidence tag:
Displays verbatim snippet from source PDF.
Citations stripped clean for human recruiters.
